newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing N.Star issues shrs for allotment.
newsitem.headline: Beijing N.Star issues shrs for allotment.

text.p: Chinese property development and investment group Beijing North Star Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would issue an additional 64.55 million H-shares at HK$2.40 each to cover over-allotment.
H-shares are shares of Chinese state-owned enterprises listed in Hong Kong.

The company said HSBC Investment Bank Asia, on behalf of the underwriters, exercised the balance of the over-allotment option requiring the company to issue 64.55 million new shares, or 3.46 percent of the share capital.
Dealing in the additional shares is expected to begin on May 22, it said.
Last week, HSBC partially exercised the over-allotment option to require Beijing North Star to issue 27.66 million additional shares.
Beijing North Star offered 614.8 million H-shares at HK$2.40 each in flotation. The shares debuted on the Hong Kong stock exchange on May 14.
On Monday, the shares closed at HK$4.075.
